exchanges.author: c_ben
exchanges.body: Harper, PDH certificates. 4B's scanner died at two-fifty, so there are almost no scans for 4B. The volunteer's sign-in sheet has twenty-nine signatures and the time she switched. How do I credit 4B?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Use the sheet as the attendance record for 4B: the 29 who signed, and anyone scanned before 14:50, get 1.0 PDH, with a note in the record that 4B came from the sign-in sheet after the scanner failed.

exchanges.author: c_ben
exchanges.body: And people who say they were in 4B but didn't sign?

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Only if the room volunteer can confirm them, as with Karla's request today; otherwise no credit. Credit follows the attendance record, not claims.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: 4B PDH: scanner failed 14:50. Credit 1.0 PDH to the 29 on the volunteer's sign-in sheet and anyone scanned before 14:50; record notes the source. Unsigned claims only if the room volunteer confirms.

documents.title: The Lennox Hotel Columbus group agreement, draft 1 (Spring Summit 2027)

versions.author: c_lennox
versions.content:
# The Lennox Hotel Columbus: group sales agreement, draft 2
Group: GLSFE Spring Facilities Summit. Dates: arrive Monday, April 12, 2027; depart Wednesday, April 14, 2027.

1. Rooms: Mon 4/12 60, Tue 4/13 90 (150 room-nights) at $179 single/double, plus applicable taxes. Cutoff Friday,
   March 12, 2027.
2. Attrition: the group agrees to use at least 75% of the room block, measured cumulatively over the block.
   Rooms the hotel resells from the block are credited against any shortfall, which is billed at the group rate.
3. Food and beverage minimum: $37,500 before the 25% service charge and tax (250 attendees at $150 per person).
4. Meeting space: Buckeye Ballroom and four breakout rooms, Tue 4/13-Wed 4/14. Rental $6,000, waived if the F&B
   minimum is met.
5. Cancellation by the group, as a percentage of anticipated revenue ($64,350: rooms $26,850 plus the F&B
   minimum): from signing to January 12, 2027, 25%; January 13 to February 11, 2027, 50%; after February 11,
   2027, 100%.
6. Deposit: $5,000 on signing, applied to the master account.
7. Force majeure: either party may terminate without liability if an act of God, war, terrorism, government
   order, disaster or epidemic makes the event illegal, impossible, inadvisable or commercially impracticable.
8. This offer is held until Friday, November 13, 2026. Signature: the group's authorized signatory.

versions.content:
# Fall Technical Conference 2026: post-event report (draft)

Attendance: 401 checked in of 412 registered (97.3%), plus 41 exhibitor staff.
F&B served vs guarantee: breakfast 344 / 360; lunch 389 / 380; reception 281 / 315. Our show-rate method underestimated lunch (92% assumed; 94.4% of registrants ate) and the floor cost us 16 breakfasts and 34 receptions. Next year: negotiate a lower floor for breakfast and the reception (80%).
Rooms: 173 room-nights of 220 (78.6%); attrition charge $189 after resale.
Budget: F&B $71,066.98 (budget $72,000, after the folio correction); AV $26,850 (budget $24,500); captioning $1,225 (unbudgeted); contingency used $3,575 of $5,000.
Accessibility: captioning for one attendee, freeze fixed by a wired feed in 3 minutes; wheelchair seating provided.
Issues: badge printer jam at 07:25 (pre-printed badges), unlabeled GF plate at table 14, Salon 1 reset to 130 seats.
Survey: going out Monday; results in two weeks.
